title: ForceCloseRequest
description: Update payload for PositionWorkflow.force_close. Validator checks operator_id is non-empty. Handler cancels any in-flight exit, then places a marketable-to-bid SELL for the full remaining qty (no floor in v0/paper). If remainingQty == 0 after cancel-ack, the handler audits ForceCloseNoop and returns. WaitPolicy=Accepted: HTTP 202 returns immediately with the new exit_signal_id; operator polls position_state for completion.

reason.description: Free-form operator-supplied reason recorded on ForceCloseRequested audit event.
